ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.re: Craft in a 3×3 grid: leather on the corners and sides, string on top, any Poké Ball in the center, and one leather below the ball.
ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.ti: Great, Ultra, and Master Balls upgrade pouch capacity and appearance.

ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.st: String makes the shoulder strap on the top row.
item.ancient_extensions.ancient_professo: Right-click open ground ahead to pitch a comfort survey camp—fire, tent, bedroll, and a supply chest.
ancient_extensions.kit.welcome: The Ancient Professor left you a Field Kit. Open your inventory and right-click it on open ground.
ancient_extensions.kit.welcome_hint: Pitch your camp to begin the Regional Survey.
ancient_extensions.kit.tooltip_use: Faces open ground in front of you when used.
ancient_extensions.kit.lectern_hint: The Regional Survey Briefing is on the camp lectern—take a copy from your pack too.
ancient_extensions.kit.given: Ancient Professor's Field Kit added to your inventory.
ancient_extensions.kit.deployed: You pitched the survey camp—a fire, tent, and bedroll are ready. Open the chest for backup supplies.
ancient_extensions.kit.comfort_hint: Rest by the campfire or use the bedroll. Starter gear is in the camp chest.
ancient_extensions.kit.inventory_hint: Starter supplies are in your inventory. Read the briefing on the camp lectern.
ancient_extensions.kit.chest_only_hint: Starter supplies are in the camp chest—open it to gear up.
ancient_extensions.kit.bed_spawn_hint: Right-click the camp bed to set your respawn point here.
ancient_extensions.kit.sleeping_bag_hint: A sleeping bag is laid out by the fire—right-click it to rest without moving your spawn.
ancient_extensions.kit.lootr_hint: The camp chest uses Lootr—every player gets their own starter supplies.
ancient_extensions.kit.survey_hint: Only catches count toward the Regional Survey (PC storage does not). Use /ancientextensions survey
ancient_extensions.kit.chest_hint: Open the camp chest for your starter Poké Balls and medicine.
ancient_extensions.kit.already_used: This kit has already been opened on your journey.
ancient_extensions.kit.no_space: There is not enough open ground nearby to pitch the camp. Try a clearer area.
ancient_extensions.advancement.pitch_fie: Pitch the Ancient Professor's field camp to begin the Regional Survey.

ancient_extensions.region.kanto.blurb: The classic heartland—oak routes, league dreams, and endless tall grass.
ancient_extensions.region.johto.blurb: Legends linger among towers and quiet routes between mountains and sea.
ancient_extensions.region.hoenn.blurb: Land and sea intertwine; volcanic paths and tropical shores shape every survey.
ancient_extensions.region.sinnoh.blurb: Mythic peaks and harsh winters—migratory lines bend around Mount Coronet.
ancient_extensions.region.unova.blurb: Urban skylines and distant frontiers—contrasts that define modern field work.
ancient_extensions.region.kalos.blurb: Elegant valleys and radiant meadows where beauty and battle meet.
ancient_extensions.region.alola.blurb: Island chains and guardian spirits—every leg of migration crosses open ocean.
ancient_extensions.region.galar.blurb: Rolling wild areas and stadium culture—open moors host seasonal wanderers.
ancient_extensions.region.paldea.blurb: A vast open region—treasure hunts and terastal light guide surveyors inland.
